strings.오, 모험가님은 분명…. %s 님이시군요. 폐하를 도와 용제성 사건을 해: Oh, you must be... %s. The adventurer who helped Her Majesty resolve the Dragon Emperor's Palace incident...
I'm Levi Tation of the Jiendia Empire's inspection corps.
strings.표정을 보니 이름을 듣고 당황하셨군요. 많은 분들이 그런 반응을 보이셨으: Judging by your expression, my name surprised you. Many people react that way.
Yes. I share his given name, but our family names are different.
Oh, I see. I didn't realize...
It's all right. Let me introduce myself again.
I'm Levi, eldest son of the Tation family of the Jiendia Empire.
Her Majesty has spoken of you often. She says you're a truly excellent adventurer...
It's an honor to meet you.
And I'd like to thank you on Her Majesty's behalf.
Your dedication has saved countless innocent lives, and will save many more...
strings.모험가님께서 조사단을 도와주시겠다는 말씀 들었습니다. 지금 이곳 사정이: I heard you've agreed to help our investigation team. The situation here is poor, so there is much to do.
So I'll get straight to the point, %s.
strings.저희 조사단, 정확히는 감찰단은 여기 드룰리지 마을 부근에서 마석의 흔적: Our investigation team, more precisely the inspection corps, found traces of magic stones near Drulridge Village. We couldn't understand why traces of the stones from the Dragon Emperor's Palace were here.
strings.조사를 이어가던 중, 게미누스라는 트윈 헤드 오우거가 오우거 부대를 이끌: As we continued investigating, we learned that a twin-headed ogre named Geminus was leading an ogre force and threatening Drulridge.
strings.드룰리지가 함락된다면 미르간디아 지역이 모두 위험해질 수 있기 때문에 저: If Drulridge falls, all of Mirgandia could be in danger, so we decided to join forces with a nearby mercenary company.
We divided our people between searching for the source of the magic stones and fighting the ogres.
strings.그리고 용병단 덕분에 마석 파편을 발견할 수 있었습니다. 용병단 안에 마: Thanks to the mercenaries, we found fragments of magic stones. One of their members, though not a mage, was quite knowledgeable and helped greatly.
strings.하지만 그 과정에서 오우거 부대의 습격이 있었고, 그들을 막아내느라 마을: But during that process, the ogres attacked, and the village suffered damage while we held them off.
strings.일단 먼저 이 드룰리지를 구하는 것이 먼저입니다. 그래야 조사를 계속 이: First, we must save Drulridge. Only then can we continue our investigation.
It's fortunate that you've come at such a difficult time, %s.
strings.그러니 도와주실 수 있겠습니까? 물론, 저희를 도와주신다면 원하시는 정보: Will you help us? Of course, if you do, we'll provide the information you want as well.
I made a promise to Her Majesty too...
strings.감사합니다. 역시 폐하께서 말씀하신 그대로의 분이시군요. 자세한 이야기는: Thank you. You really are exactly as Her Majesty described. You'll hear the details from Ferdinand.
I'm sorry I can't accompany you. I have my own work to attend to.
It's all right. It can't be helped.
strings.(페르디난드에게 간단하게 자기 소개를 한다. 그러자 페르디난드가 알았다는: (I briefly introduce myself to Ferdinand. He nods in understanding.)
strings.이곳 마을 주민들은 모두 드루이드들이오. 자연을 믿고 따르는 일족인데,: Everyone in this village is a druid. Our people believe in nature and follow its ways. After seeking a place with the purest energy, we settled here.
strings.그렇게 우리들은 100년 동안 행복했소. 그런데 마을이 불안해진 건 1년: We lived happily for a hundred years. But a year ago, the twin-headed ogre Geminus appeared from the north and disturbed our peace.
strings.머리가 두 개 달린 기형 오우거요. 미르간디아에 그런 오우거가 있었다는: An ogre born with two heads. We didn't even know such an ogre existed in Mirgandia.
strings.그런 게미누스가 이 부근 몬스터를 비롯해 여러 이종족들을 힘으로 제압하면: Geminus subdued the nearby monsters and other races by force, growing his power. Then he forced us humans to make a choice too.
strings.너희 또한 힘에 지배될 것이다, 라면서…. 그래서 죽을 것인지, 굴복할: He said, 'You too will be ruled by strength.' We were to choose between death and submission.
How could humans bow to a monster with not a trace of dignity?
So we chose to resist, and we have defended our village against them for a long time.
strings.하지만 최고 전사인 클라우드가 상처를 입은 바람에 우리는 패배하는 날이: But our finest warrior, Cloud, was injured, and since then we've suffered more and more defeats.
strings.…이런 이야기를 외지인에게 하는 것이 부끄럽지만, 어쩔 수 없는 거 아니: ...It's shameful to tell an outsider all this, but what choice do we have? You are someone who has offered to help...
That's why we asked the Oscuras Mercenaries, with whom we had ties, for assistance.
strings.게미누스의 몬스터 부대도 점차 늘어나고 있던 차에 잘 됐지만, 그래도 그: It was good timing, since Geminus's monster army was growing. But even then, we lacked the strength to face them.
strings.때맞춰 지엔디아 제국의 감찰단이 등장했고, 위대한 모험가인 그대가 오게: Then the Jiendia Empire's inspection corps arrived, and now you, a great adventurer, have come.
We've only made it this far through everyone's efforts, but it still isn't enough.
I see. So that's what happened.
strings.몬스터들을 모두 처리하면 되는 건가요?: Should I deal with all the monsters?
Hmm... It isn't a problem that can be handled so simply.
strings.그 문제는 나보다는 오스큐라스 용병단의 단장과 상의하는 게 좋겠소. 어린: You should discuss that with the Oscuras company's leader rather than me. She may be a young girl, but she is exceptionally skilled at directing people in battle.
All right. I'll go see Parmila.
strings.어, %s, 오랜만이야. 촌장님께 이야기 듣고 왔어? 그러면 우리가 지금: Oh, %s! It's been a while. Did the village chief fill you in? Then I'll explain what we've done so far and how.
strings.우리 단원 바르문이 버섯의 숲에서 마석을 발견했어. 정확히 말하면 마석을: Our member Barmun discovered a magic stone in Mushroom Forest. More precisely, a monster carrying one.
strings.몬스터에게서 마석이 나왔어요?: A magic stone came from a monster?
strings.이거 좀 복잡하게 돌아가고 있어. 현재 우리는 제국, 드루이드 마을과 연: Things are getting complicated. We're working with the Empire and the druid village on several tasks.
First, guarding and securing the Mushroom Forest area.
Second, watching the Destroyed Castle, the base of Geminus and his monster army.
And third, tracing the source of the magic stones.
The imperial inspection corps is helping with guard duties, so we've taken on that last task.
We have our own aims, and they have theirs. Our interests line up. It's a kind of deal.
strings.뭔가 복잡하네요. 그래서 제가 무엇을 하면 되는 거죠?: It's complicated. So what should I do?
strings.흠, 잠깐 기다려. 너 지금 제국의 의뢰를 받은 상태라 우리 쪽의 일을: Hmm, wait. You're currently working on a request from the Empire, so technically you aren't doing our work.
strings.마석 근원지만 찾으면 될 줄 알고 있겠지만…: You may think you only need to find the source of the stones, but...
strings.아, 모르겠다. 일단 게미누스의 부하들을 막는 일부터 해줬으면 해. 잠깐: Oh, never mind. I'd like you to start by holding off Geminus's subordinates. It'll only take a moment.
Do you need to think about it? If it's unclear, go back and speak to the imperial inspection commander.
strings.그게 아니라면 즉시 버섯의 숲 경계 지역으로 가 봐. 용병단원 바르문하고: Otherwise, head straight to the Mushroom Forest boundary. Our mercenary Barmun and the druid warrior Herais are there. Help them.
The number of monsters keeps growing. The two of them alone will struggle.
strings.…도와줄 거지? 물론, 사례는 할게. 여기저기서 돈 받을 일이 많아졌거든: ...You'll help, right? Of course, I'll pay you. We have more and more payments due from various places.
strings.이야기를 들었는데, 도와드려야겠죠?: Now that I've heard the situation, I should help, shouldn't I?
strings.숲에 진입하면 몬스터들이 보일텐데, 가만히 두지마. 전부다 게미누스의 부: When you enter the forest, you'll see monsters. Don't leave them alone. They're all Geminus's subordinates.
strings.그러니 조심해. 오우거가 바보같고 무식하다는 이야기는 모두 옛날 이야기니: So be careful. All those stories about ogres being foolish and ignorant are old news now. Understood?
Thank you for worrying, Parmila. I'll be going.
strings.오셨군요. 상황이 상황이니만큼 바로 설명을 드릴게요. 마석이 발견된 지역: You're here. Given the situation, I'll explain right away. The magic stones were found right here in Mushroom Forest.
strings.이 지역 이 종족들은 모두 게미누스에게 복종했다고 봐도 돼요. 인간을 보: You can assume all the nonhuman groups in this area have submitted to Geminus. They keep attacking humans, so we've been dealing with them whenever we spot them.
strings.그러던 중, 이상한 일이 일어났죠. 유난히 강했던 홉고블린을 쓰러뜨리고: Then something strange happened. I defeated an unusually strong hobgoblin and checked what it dropped... It was a magic stone.
strings.어떤 종류의 마석인지 알 수 없지만, 그 마석이 고블린의 힘을 증폭시켜주: I couldn't tell what kind, but it seemed to amplify the goblin's strength.
I collected some samples, and then the imperial inspection corps arrived.
strings.레비 테이션이라는 사람은 만나 보셨죠? 여성들이 좋아할 만한 외모를 가지: You've met Levi Tation, right? He has the kind of looks women like.
I think plenty of people besides me would agree.
strings.저런 사람도 외모 콤플렉스가 있을까?: I wonder if someone like that has insecurities about his appearance.
strings.후후, 제발 있었으면 좋겠어요. 그래야 우리 같은 사람이 덜 억울할 테니: Hehe. I hope he does. It would make people like us feel less cheated!
strings.(아니, 왜 이야기가 그렇게 흘러가지?): (Wait, why has the conversation gone in this direction?)
Anyway, it's frustrating not knowing where the stones come from.
strings.일단 이 부근 몬스터들을 조사해서 찾아보는 수밖에요. 바보같은 방법이긴: For now, all we can do is investigate the monsters nearby. It's a clumsy method, but it's the best we have.
If we trace where they appear, we may find out.
I think we have less time than we realize. We should hurry.
Then I'll take that side. %s, you take the opposite direction.
All right. Be careful too, Barmun.
strings.아니요…. 이렇게 달려드는 몬스터들을 처리했는데 단서가 될만한 것이 별로: No... After dealing with all those monsters charging at us, there was hardly anything useful as a clue...
strings.정말 모르겠네요. 이 근방 몬스터들은 게미누스의 수하가 아닌 건가?: I really don't understand. Are the monsters around here not Geminus's followers?
strings.또 다른 세력이 있을 수도 있다는 건가요?: Are you saying there could be another faction?
strings.그럴 수도 있을 것 같아요. 흐음, 어떻게 하시겠어요? 아무래도 다른 곳: It's possible. Hmm, what will you do? You may have to investigate somewhere else...
strings.혹시 저 말고 다른 사람이 밖에 나와있다는 말씀은 들으셨죠?: You heard there was someone besides me out here, right?
strings.헤레이스…, 자칭 드루이드 최고 전사. 제가 보기엔 그렇게 보여요. 클라: Herais... The self-proclaimed greatest druid warrior. Self-proclaimed, as far as I'm concerned. That older fellow Cloud looked stronger to me...
strings.(바르문이 헤레이스에게 화가 난 것 같은 표정이다.): (Barmun looks as though he's angry with Herais.)
strings.저는 여기에 있을 테니, 가시려면 혼자 가세요. 그 사람과 마주치기 싫으: I'll stay here. If you're going, go alone. I don't want to run into him.
He growled at me to stay away from the women in the village.
What kind of man does he take me for...?
All I did was compliment the beauty of the druid women.
He got angry and said I had no grasp of the situation.
I can see why he might.
Anyway, I'll keep looking here for magic stones dropped by monsters.
All right. Then I'll go to Herais.
strings.(…여기는 바르문에게 맡기고 어서 헤레이스를 찾아보자.): (...Let's leave this place to Barmun and find Herais quickly.)
I need to get back to the village, but in this condition... Urgh... Cough, cough.
strings.저기, 괜찮으세요?: Excuse me, are you all right?
How did you get this far? I don't recognize your face...
strings.드룰리지 마을의 헤레이스 맞죠?: You're Herais from Drulridge Village, right?
...If you know my name... then you must be...
strings.(헤레이스에게 여기까지 오게 된 경위에 대해서 이야기한다.): (I explain to Herais how I came here.)
Don't be so wary. I came to help.
strings.우리 마을을 돕는 척, 마석을 찾는 먼 대륙의 제국 일을 하고 있는데 경: You're working for an empire on a distant continent, searching for magic stones while pretending to help our village, and you tell me not to be wary? Amusing.
I understand what you mean. In any case, I'm glad you're not an enemy.
strings.뭐가 어떻든 간에 지금은 나를 도와라. 지금 내가 부상을 입어서 움직일: Whatever your reasons, help me now. I'm injured and can't move.
Bring me slime from the Spot Bubbles wandering around the forest.
With that, I can quickly make some medicine. Cough, cough...
I-I see. Stay right here, then. I'll be back soon.
What an interesting outsider... Cough, cough...
Thank you. My wounds have healed a little thanks to you.
...Then I'll tell you what you want to know.
The source of the magic stones...
strings.저 동굴이 얼마 전에 나타난 '숨겨진 동굴'이다. 저 곳이 바로 마석의: That cave is the Hidden Cave that appeared recently. You could call it the source of the magic stones.
strings.저 안에는 마석을 품은 괴물들이 가득하고, 그 괴물들을 움직이는 존재가: It's filled with monsters carrying magic stones, and there's a being inside directing them.
Yes. A dark sorcerer who turned himself undead in pursuit of immortality.
I don't know his name, but he must be connected to the magic stones.
strings.흑마술의 정점에 가까웠던 자가 스스로를 리치로 만들었겠지. 흑마술의 지식: Someone near the pinnacle of dark sorcery must have made himself a lich. He surely used his knowledge of dark magic to create the stones.
The stones found around here seem to have been influenced by dark sorcery.
Herais, did the lich cause those injuries...?
How shameful. A warrior of Drulridge, reduced to this...
A lich wouldn't be an easy opponent...
strings.하여튼, 녀석을 처치하면 마석 제작에 대한 단서를 알 수 있겠죠?: Anyway, if I defeat him, we should find a clue about how the stones are made, right?
strings.설마 너, 리치를 상대할 생각이냐? 어리석은 선택이다. 나도 당해내지 못: Don't tell me you intend to face the lich? That's foolish. Even I couldn't handle him...
I still have to try. We won't learn anything if I don't.
So you're going inside now? I won't stop you, but...
Be careful. Don't underestimate anything in that cave.
All right. I'll go inside and find the lich.
strings.돌아왔군. 그렇다는 건 리치를 쓰러뜨린 건가?: You're back. Does that mean you defeated the lich?
strings.네, 조금 힘들었어요. 그곳에서 이런 책을 발견했는데, 보시겠어요?: Yes. It was a little difficult. I found this book there. Would you like to see it?
strings.책 표지에 '네판두스'라고 써 있던데, 역시 그 리치 이름이겠죠?: The cover says 'Nepandus.' That must be the lich's name, right?
The dark sorcerer Nepandus himself... No wonder he was so strong.
Hundreds of years ago, he was a dangerous man who declared he would create a kingdom of darkness. He threatened everyone with dark magic, particularly necromancy.
strings.너는 잘 모르겠지만, 오래 전 프레이오스에 큰 분쟁이 있었지. 그때를 이: You may not know this, but Freios suffered a major conflict long ago. Nepandus tried to exploit it to make himself king.
strings.그러나 지금의 실바리아 제국의 전신인 왕국을 비롯해 여러 세력이 이를 알: But several powers, including the kingdom that preceded today's Silvaria Empire, discovered his scheme and formed an allied army to defeat him.
strings.분명 연합군에 패배해 종적을 감췄다고 들었는데…. 이렇게 시간이 흘러 리: I heard he was defeated and vanished without a trace... To think he'd spent all this time as a lich.
A fitting end for a fool who defied the world's natural order and became undead.
The information you want should be in this book...
Go and report to that man Levi.
strings.헤레이스는 마을로 돌아가지 않아도 괜찮아요?: Are you all right staying here, Herais? Shouldn't you return to the village?
You're worried about me? Ridiculous. Focus on your own business.
strings.나는 저 동굴의 상황을 계속 살펴볼테니 어서 돌아가라. 그곳에서도 네가: I'll keep watching that cave. Go back. They'll be waiting for you there.
Good. Then I wish you luck.
strings.으음, 이 책이 그런 것이군요. 살짝만 봐도 네판두스가 자신의 근황과 연: Hmm, so that's what this book is. At a glance, it looks like a journal in which Nepandus recorded his circumstances and research results.
Let me read a little more before I explain.
strings.(레비가 한참 동안 심각한 표정으로 책 내용을 확인한다.): (Levi studies the book for a long time with a grave expression.)
There's no doubt that Nepandus created the magic stones.
It seems Nepandus's stones were used to break through the Dragon Emperor's Palace barrier.
But Nepandus didn't do it himself, so we need to investigate further.
...Then it was the one seen at the palace...
strings.그 붉은 장발의 아가슈라 남자인가요?: The Agasura man with long red hair?
strings.잠깐 그 이야기가 이 책에 있는 건가요?: Wait, does the book mention him?
Guiyi definitely told me about that person too.
strings.이 책을 보면 네판두스는 동굴에 숨어있다 그대로 죽음을 맞이한 것 같습니: According to this book, Nepandus hid in the cave and eventually died there.
I don't know why he never came out again, but something must have happened.
strings.헤레이스에게서 네판두스의 이야기를 잠깐 들었어요. 연합군에게 패배하고 종: Herais told me a little about Nepandus. He was defeated by an allied army, disappeared, and took refuge in the cave...
strings.그런데 어떻게 리치가 된거죠?: But how did he become a lich?
strings.그 아가슈라 남자가 죽은 그를 부활시켰고, 부활한 리치는 그의 명령으로: That Agasura man brought him back from the dead, and the revived lich acted on his orders...
strings.리치가 됐어도 기록하는 버릇을 못 버린 것 같습니다. 여기 다 적혀있군요: Even as a lich, he couldn't break the habit of keeping records. It's all written here. Anyway, I'll submit a report based on this.
strings.그 동안, 모험가님은 용병단의 일을 도와주셨으면 합니다. 안 그래도 그: Meanwhile, please help the mercenaries. We'd heard of ogre movements at the castle, and our investigation showed...
strings.게미누스가 본거지로 쓰고 있는 것 같습니다. 바로 버섯의 숲 외곽에 있는: It seems Geminus is using it as his base. The [Destroyed Castle] on the edge of Mushroom Forest.
strings.용병단이 경계하고 있는데 버거운 모양입니다. %s 님이 합류해주신다면…: The mercenaries are watching it, but they're struggling. If you join them, %s... I'm sure you'll be a great help.
Then I'll go. Don't worry too much.
They said reinforcements were coming. I didn't expect them to be you, %s...
It's been a long time, Arcane. I'm glad you seem well.
I'm relieved you're here, but it's difficult to explain clearly.
Facing Geminus is one thing, but the village has its own circumstances too.
strings.일단, 마을과 우리의 사정에 대해서는 어느 정도 알고 있지?: You know something of the village's situation and ours, right?
strings.지금 우리는 몬스터 부대의 방어만 하기에도 힘든 상황이네. 언제까지 이럴: At the moment, we're struggling just to defend against the monster army. We can't go on like this forever... So we've made a decision.
A surprise attack. But we don't have anyone with the ability to carry it out.
Everyone is skilled, but they lack experience facing monsters like these.
It might be different if the companions who followed our former leader were here, but as we are now, we aren't enough.
So thank you for coming to help.
You should be able to face that twin-headed ogre, Geminus.
strings.그렇게 말씀을 하시니 겁이 나는데, 제가 할 수 있을까요?: When you put it that way, I'm a little scared. Can I really do it?
I only came thinking I'd offer a little help.
strings.잡입에 도움이 될만한 정보를 주겠네. 지금 이시간만 되면 오우거들이 조용: I'll give you information that should help you infiltrate. The ogres tend to be quiet at this time of day. This is our best chance.
strings.나는 이 앞에서 밖으로 나오는 오우거들을 처리할 테니 자네가 안을 맡아주: I'll deal with any ogres coming out here. You handle the inside.
...Since you put it that way, I'll go meet Geminus.
strings.크윽…. 크윽…. 인간, 강하군. 날 죽이려면 충분히 죽일 수 있을텐데,: Urgh... Urgh... You're strong, human. You could easily kill me if you wished. Why don't you?
...You look as though there's much you want to know.
strings.게미누스, 넌 어디서 온거지? 왜 이곳에서 군대를 일으켜 인간의 마을을: Geminus, where did you come from? Why did you raise an army here and attack a human village?
Do you think I'll simply answer that?
strings.지금까지 어디 있었는지도 몰랐던 트윈 헤드 오우거가 나타나난 걸 보면 의: A twin-headed ogre nobody knew existed suddenly appears. It's full of questions.
strings.나는 그저 창조주의 명령에 따라 움직일 뿐…. 그분께서 원하는 게 아니면: I act only on my creator's orders... Unless he wishes it, I will not answer.
strings.(게미누스가 답을 하지 않는다. 어떤 힘의 작용으로 인해 몸이 점점 굳어: (Geminus does not answer. Under the influence of some force, his body gradually stiffens.)
strings.(게미누스의 몸에서 어떤 생기도 느껴지지 않는다.): (No trace of life can be felt from Geminus's body.)
strings.뭐지…? 대체 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는 거야?: What...? What on earth is happening?
strings.게미누스가 그런 말을 했다고? 흐음…. 설마 진짜 창조신 같은 걸 말하는: Geminus said that? Hmm... Surely he didn't mean an actual creator god...
strings.어렵네. 누군가 실험을 통해 게미누스라는, 트윈 헤드 오우거를 강제로 만: It's difficult. It sounds as though someone forcibly created a twin-headed ogre called Geminus through experiments...
Who on earth would plan such a thing...?
strings.저도 그게 의심스러워요. 대체 왜 미르간디아에서 그러는 걸까요?: That's what I'm wondering too. Why do it in Mirgandia?
strings.잘은 모르지만, 네판두스가 여기 있어서 그런 건 아닐까?: I don't know, but could it be because Nepandus was here?
Whoever created Geminus must have come because something they wanted was here.
strings.어떤 일로 인해 미르간디아를 바탕으로 하려는 일이 있는 거지. 게미누스를: They had a plan that required a base in Mirgandia. They created Geminus to lead a monster army and needed land for them to occupy...
strings.그래서 게미누스에게 그 일을 지시한 거지. 마침 드룰리지가 방해가 된 거: So they ordered Geminus to secure it. Drulridge happened to stand in the way...
It feels as though the pieces are fitting together.
strings.아무튼 우두머리가 쓰러졌으니 나머지는 어떻게든 되겠군. 고마워, 게미누스: Anyway, now that the leader has fallen, we'll manage the rest somehow. Thank you. With Geminus dealt with, that weight is off my mind.
We'll handle the aftermath. Tell our leader what happened.
You've worked hard. See you again.
strings.(파르밀라가 %s에게서 그동안 버섯의 숲과 파괴된 성에 있었던 일들을 듣: (Parmila looks puzzled after hearing %s's account of what happened in Mushroom Forest and the Destroyed Castle.)
I see. Nepandus and Geminus... There must be a connection.
After hearing Arcane's thoughts, I think so too.
strings.네판두스가 부활하고, 게미누스가 만들어지고…. 역시 뭔가 있는게 맞겠지?: Nepandus was revived, Geminus was created... There has to be something behind it, right?
Thanks to you, things should be easier for Drulridge. The biggest danger is gone.
Then perhaps you can rest a little.
Hmm... You're still putting the pieces together.
strings.맞아. 정말 이런 상상하기 싫은데, 만약에 말이지. 여기 드룰리지를 마석: Yes. I really don't want to imagine it, but what if they intended to turn Drulridge into a magic stone research facility or a military base...?
strings.확실히 그럴 거 같아요. 그래도 지금은 아니니까 괜찮겠죠?: It certainly seems possible. But it won't happen now, so we're all right, aren't we?
We've put an end to that person's plans.
strings.…은근 자기 때문에 끝났다고 자랑하는 것 같네?: ...Are you subtly boasting that you ended them yourself?
You acknowledged me, Parmila, so I thought it was all right.
The druids and mercenaries joined forces, and I added my strength too. With all that...
I feel as though I've grown stronger than before.
strings.그런데 왜 그렇게 보세요?: But why are you looking at me like that?
strings.(파르밀라가 묘한 눈빛으로 %s의 얼굴을 바라보고 있다.): (Parmila gazes at %s's face with an unreadable expression.)
strings.파르밀라, 왜 아무말이 없어요?: Parmila, why aren't you saying anything?
strings.파르밀라? 혹시 제가 무슨 잘못했나요?: Parmila? Did I do something wrong?
No, no. Go to Levi and tell him what you've been through.
strings.수고했어. 후후. 그럼 나중에 만나. 일단 우리 용병단도 정리되는 대로: Good work. Hehe. See you later. Our company should return to camp once everything is settled here.
strings.이번엔 잘 해결되긴 했는데, 실바리아 제국의 황제 폐하께선 대체 무슨 생: Things worked out this time, but what on earth is the emperor of Silvaria thinking...?
And even setting the Jiendia continent aside...
